summary: The bill amends the Immigration and Nationality Act to bar admission and naturalization, require deportation, and permit denaturalization of any alien who advocates for, belongs to, or distributes material supporting socialist, communist, Chinese communist, Marxist, or Islamic fundamentalist parties or doctrines, while removing most exceptions, lowering the age threshold to 14, and eliminating judicial review of these decisions.

scores.thoughts: The bill amends immigration law to restrict admission, naturalization, and enable deportation/denaturalization based on ideological affiliations. It contains no provisions related to federal budgets, appropriations, or expenditures.
The bill makes no changes to tax law, rates, deductions, or revenue collection.
No provisions address healthcare policy, insurance, public programs, or market regulations.
The legislation does not mention firearms, Second Amendment issues, or related regulations.

This bill exclusively amends the Immigration and Nationality Act to expand inadmissibility, deportability, and denaturalization grounds for membership, affiliation, or advocacy of socialist, communist, Marxist, Chinese communist, or Islamic fundamentalist doctrines. It broadens existing totalitarian party bars, lowers age thresholds, removes certain exceptions, adds new advocacy and material support prohibitions, and makes determinations non-reviewable. This directly and primarily restricts immigration pathways and strengthens border/immigration enforcement based on ideology.
No references to reproductive rights, abortion access, or related regulations.
The bill contains no provisions on defense spending, military policy, or national security appropriations.
No environmental, climate, or regulatory provisions are present.
The legislation does not address welfare programs, entitlements, or social services.
No provisions relate to schools, federal education funding, or school choice.
The bill makes no changes to drug enforcement, decriminalization, or controlled substances policy.

While the bill expands grounds for removal and denaturalization, these are immigration-specific civil/administrative actions rather than criminal sentencing, policing reforms, or rehabilitation measures. No impact on domestic criminal justice system.
No provisions on tariffs, trade agreements, or globalization.
The bill has no fiscal provisions affecting deficits or debt.
No references to LGBTQ+ protections or related civil rights.
The legislation does not address foreign assistance or international aid programs.
No provisions on voting access, election integrity, or electoral processes.
The bill makes no changes to technology regulation, data privacy, or surveillance policy.
Although socialist parties are referenced in definitions, the bill does not alter labor law, union rights, or employer regulations.
The bill targets Islamic fundamentalist doctrines for immigration restrictions but does not modify domestic religious liberty protections, anti-discrimination laws, or exemptions.
